module mg_01493 (input clk,input reset,input go,input [7:0] data,output match,output done);
reg [2:0] af_state; 
  always @(posedge clk) 
  if(reset) 
  af_state <= 0; 
  else 
  if(go) 
  af_state <= (data[0] == 1'b0) ? 1 : 7; 
  else 
  case(af_state) 
  1 : af_state <= 2; 
  2 : af_state <= 3; 
  3 : af_state <= 4; 
  4 : af_state <= 5; 
  5 : af_state <= 6; 
  6, 7 : af_state <= 0; 
  endcase 
  assign match = (af_state==6); 
  assign done = (af_state==6)|(af_state==7); 
 endmodule
